# Claude Code Undocumented Env Vars

An env var is a named setting that Claude Code reads from the shell.
Most of the names that the program reads are not in the official docs.
For example, `CLAUDE_CODE_COORDINATOR_MODE=1` turns on coordinator mode.
Of its 1111 rows, 1050 are found only in the program, 12 differ from the docs, and 222 work only behind a flag or a gate.
Anthropic can change or remove each item in any release.

## Found Only in the Program

1050 items are in the program but not in the official docs.
These are the most useful ones.

- `OTEL_SPAN_EVENT_COUNT_LIMIT`: Limits the events on each span. See [Env Vars Telemetry and Debug](Claude-Code-Env-Vars-Telemetry-And-Debug).
- `CLAUDE_CODE_DEBUG_REPAINTS`: Turns on the repaint debug mode of the terminal renderer. See [Env Vars UI and Terminal](Claude-Code-Env-Vars-UI-And-Terminal).
- `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_LOGS_INSECURE`: Makes the gRPC OTLP logs exporter use an insecure channel when `true`. See [Env Vars Telemetry and Debug](Claude-Code-Env-Vars-Telemetry-And-Debug).
- `GRPC_SSL_CIPHER_SUITES`: Sets the TLS cipher suites of the bundled gRPC library. See [Env Vars Third Party and System](Claude-Code-Env-Vars-Third-Party-And-System).
- `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_OUTCOME_CODES`: Turns on outcome code visibility in the auto mode classifier. See [Env Vars Tools and Bash](Claude-Code-Env-Vars-Tools-And-Bash).
- `AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_SSO_OIDC`: Overrides the AWS SSO OIDC endpoint in the bundled AWS SDK. See [Env Vars Third Party and System](Claude-Code-Env-Vars-Third-Party-And-System).
- `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROXY_AUTH_HELPER`: Turns on the `proxyAuthHelper` setting so a helper command can mint proxy auth headers. See [Env Vars Auth](Claude-Code-Env-Vars-Auth).
- `PG_SSLMODE`: Sets the TLS mode of the Postgres connection of the embedded Bun SQL client. See [Env Vars Third Party and System](Claude-Code-Env-Vars-Third-Party-And-System).
- `CLAUDE_CODE_QUESTION_EXTENDED`: Turns on extended questions in `AskUserQuestion`. See [Env Vars Tools and Bash](Claude-Code-Env-Vars-Tools-And-Bash).
- `CLAUDE_CODE_SLEEP_COMPACT_AFTER_MS`: Sets how long after a turn ends the sleep compaction may fire. See [Env Vars Context and Compaction](Claude-Code-Env-Vars-Context-And-Compaction).

## Where the Docs Differ

12 items work in a different way from what the docs say.
This is the whole list.

- `CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_COMMENTS`: Turns the reading of artifact comments on or off. See [Env Vars Features and Gates](Claude-Code-Env-Vars-Features-And-Gates).
- `CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_COMMENTS_AUTOREACT`: Lets Claude reply on its own to comments sent to it. See [Env Vars Features and Gates](Claude-Code-Env-Vars-Features-And-Gates).
- `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_ALLOWLIST_ENV`: Starts stdio MCP servers with a safe base env plus the server `env`. See [Env Vars Plugins and MCP](Claude-Code-Env-Vars-Plugins-And-MCP).
- `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_AUTO_BACKGROUND_MS`: Sets the time before a running MCP tool call moves to the background. See [Env Vars Plugins and MCP](Claude-Code-Env-Vars-Plugins-And-MCP).
- `CLAUDE_CODE_TRANSCRIPT_LOCAL_GC`: Trims the transcript before each compaction once the file passes 5 MB. See [Env Vars Sessions and Storage](Claude-Code-Env-Vars-Sessions-And-Storage).
- `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY`: Turns on OTEL metrics and logs. See [Env Vars Telemetry and Debug](Claude-Code-Env-Vars-Telemetry-And-Debug).
- `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB`: Strips credentials from the env of subprocesses such as Bash, hooks, and stdio MCP servers. See [Env Vars Tools and Bash](Claude-Code-Env-Vars-Tools-And-Bash).
- `CLAUDE_CODE_TOOL_MEMORY_LIMIT`: Caps memory for tool commands with a cgroup. See [Env Vars Tools and Bash](Claude-Code-Env-Vars-Tools-And-Bash).
- `CLAUDE_CODE_ALT_SCREEN_FULL_REPAINT`: Repaints the whole screen on each frame in fullscreen rendering. See [Env Vars UI and Terminal](Claude-Code-Env-Vars-UI-And-Terminal).
- `CLAUDE_CODE_NEW_INIT`: Makes `/init` run the interactive setup flow. See [Env Vars UI and Terminal](Claude-Code-Env-Vars-UI-And-Terminal).
- `CLAUDE_CODE_NONBLOCKING_STDOUT`: Writes terminal output through a second non-blocking descriptor so a stalled terminal cannot freeze the session. See [Env Vars UI and Terminal](Claude-Code-Env-Vars-UI-And-Terminal).
- `IS_DEMO`: Demo mode: hides the account email and organization name in the header and status output. See [Env Vars UI and Terminal](Claude-Code-Env-Vars-UI-And-Terminal).

## Behind a Flag or a Gate

222 items work only when a flag or a gate is on.
These are some of them.

- `CCR_DELTA_RESET`: Turns on a delta reset path in the CCR git fetch step and adds a `delta_reset` field to startup timing data. See [Env Vars Cloud and Remote](Claude-Code-Env-Vars-Cloud-And-Remote).
- `CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT`: Controls fork mode for subagents. See [Env Vars Agents and Teams](Claude-Code-Env-Vars-Agents-And-Teams).
- `VITALS_EMITTER_BIN`: Sets the path of the guest vitals emitter binary for remote sessions. See [Env Vars Cloud and Remote](Claude-Code-Env-Vars-Cloud-And-Remote).
- `SESSION_INGRESS_URL`: Sets the base URL of the session ingress for remote (CCR) sessions. See [Env Vars Cloud and Remote](Claude-Code-Env-Vars-Cloud-And-Remote).
- `BUN_CHROME_PATH`: Sets the Chrome binary for the artifact preview browser. See [Env Vars Features and Gates](Claude-Code-Env-Vars-Features-And-Gates).
- `CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_COMMENT_RESPONDER`: Turns on responder dispatch for artifact comment threads. See [Env Vars Features and Gates](Claude-Code-Env-Vars-Features-And-Gates).
